Application Data.NAME: Acme Heating & Refrigeration Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Acme Heating & Refrigeration Services specializes in providing comprehensive heating and refrigeration solutions for both residential and commercial clients. Our operations include installation, maintenance, and repair services for HVAC systems, refrigeration units, and related equipment. We adhere strictly to all certification requirements for refrigerant handling and ensure the use of only approved, UL-listed refrigerants. Additionally, our team is trained in environmentally responsible refrigerant disposal practices. For clients utilizing remote monitoring systems, we implement advanced cybersecurity measures to safeguard against potential threats. We also offer optional inland marine coverage to protect our tools and equipment during transport to job sites. Our commitment to safety, compliance, and customer satisfaction drives our operational excellence in the heating and refrigeration industry.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2022, a refrigerant leak occurred during a routine maintenance check at a commercial client's site, resulting in a claimed loss of $5,000. The incident was promptly addressed with immediate repairs and the refrigerant was handled in accordance with approved disposal practices. The status of the incident is closed, with no further claims related to this issue.
